claim: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse shopping agent, showing that user delegation does not automatically confer authority inside a third-party service.
verifiedFacts: Amazon blocked Muse from its marketplace.
Amazon said external agents should respect provider policies, opt-outs and transparency expectations.
inference: User permission, agent capability and target-service permission are separate grants.
Seed Loom should test service-owner consent/revocation as a distinct authority boundary. Disposition: CORE.
significance: Very high: it exposes a missing authority dimension in many agent workflows.
assumptions: Amazon's stated policy rationale materially explains the block.
knownLimitations: Meta's detailed technical response was unavailable.
